title: containers: support pruning external storage containers
body:
## Summary

Add `podman container prune --external` for storage containers not managed by Podman, including Buildah containers. Existing prune filters, including `until`, use the external container creation time. Mounted containers are retained, and failures are reported. The option works through the local and remote APIs.

The age cutoff is a cleanup policy, not a guarantee that a build is inactive; this limitation is documented.

Fixes #30030.

## Testing

- `make bin/podman` — passed on Fedora 44 ARM64
- `go test ./pkg/api/handlers/compat` — passed
- Compile checks for the changed Go packages — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed
- Added a system Bats regression test for filters and mounted containers; not run locally because `bats` and `buildah` are unavailable.
